# Halcott Magazine

> Halcott Magazine is an independent product review publication. A team of specialist editors tests and evaluates products across 30+ categories — technology, home, kitchen, and outdoor — and writes honest reviews with clear pros and cons. Reviews are written by category experts; we do not accept payment for placement, and we disclose our affiliate relationships. As an Amazon Associate we earn from qualifying purchases.

## About
- [About Us](https://halcottmagazine.com/about/): The team and how we work
- [Editorial Policy](https://halcottmagazine.com/editorial-policy/): How we review, test, and earn revenue
- [Contact](https://halcottmagazine.com/contact): Reach the editorial team
